programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: The Monkey Is Back
programme.desc: Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl. But Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire 2
programme.desc: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey 2: Cinderella
programme.desc: The convoluted continuation of the adventures of the time-traveling, now-human Monkey King, who attempts to fulfill his divine destiny.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh 2
programme.desc: The cheating husband goes bankrupt, and his house is soon to be taken by the government. A security guard is assigned to guard it while the husband goes missing. However, only the mistress stays alone in the house. Will the lonely, handsome guard and the heartbroken mistress hook up?

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: God Of Gamblers 2
programme.desc: Multi talented Cho wants to learn from the God of Gamblers and contacts his disciple. They are attacked by a crime boss with a plan to misuse GoG's good name to make millions.

programme.title: Hail The Judge
programme.desc: A judge tries to save a female innocent who's wrongly being accused for murder.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveler
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy about a murdered cop returning from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie (Chow) into avenging his death.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: The Case Of Disappearances
programme.desc: When Qing Cheng was a teenager, he was attacked by an unknown mutant monster and lost his family and memory. He was regarded by the villagers as an ominous person who would bring disaster.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team, can they team up to regain team's glory?

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident…

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A rich playboy gets blown up by a gangster when he flirts with the gangster's wife. Through a series of circumstances, his professor makes him a synthetic body that allows him to change into anything he wants.

programme.title: Abrakadabra

programme.title: Kokom (Kompilasi Komedi)
programme.desc: Program Yang Berisikan Kompilasi Video-Video Lucu Yang Viral Di Sosial Media.

programme.title: Terang Kasih
programme.desc: Siraman Rohani Kristen Yang Berkaitan Dengan Kehidupan Untuk Mendekatkan Diri Kepada Tuhan Yesus Kristus. Program Ini Akan Dibagi Menjadi Beberapa Bagian, Antara Lain Kesaksian, Renungan, Serta Konseling Yang Akan Dipandu Oleh Dua Orang Host

programme.title: Movinesia
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Yang Menghadirkan Sederet Film Pilihan Untuk Menemani Aktivitas Anda Dengan Dimeriahkan Oleh Para Pemain & Artis Papan Atas Berbakat, Dengan Cerita Ringan Seputar Kehidupan Remaja.

programme.title: Ustadz On The Road
programme.desc: Program Religi Yang Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Ustadz Yang Akan Memberikan Kajian Islami Dengan Treatment On The Road Disertai Dengan Study Kasus. Pembahasan Dilakukan Sepanjang Perjalanan Menuju Lokasi Sesuai Agenda Harian Ustadz. Program Ini Akan Disajikan Secara Ringan Dan Menyenangkan.

programme.title: Ultraman Arc
programme.desc: Ultraman Arc Bercerita Tentang Yuma Hize Yang Bergabung Ke Pusat Investigasi Dan Pencegahan Kaiju Ilmiah (Skip). Dalam Sebuah Tugas, Secara Tidak Sengaja Yuma Hize Bergabung Dengan Raksasa Cahaya Dari Galaksi Yang Jauh Dan Bertransformasi Menjadi Ultraman Arc.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Beyblade X S2
programme.desc: Tim Persona Yang Kembali Berjuang Menaklukkan X Tower, Di Tengah Guncangan Besar Dunia Beyblade Pasca-Pertarungan Sengit Melawan Ryugu Kuromu.

programme.title: Beyblade X S3
programme.desc: Beyblade X Mengikuti Ancaman Baru Dari Zero Cross (Zero Kurasu) Dan Keluarganya Yang Berencana Membangun X Tower Baru Demi Sistem Beyblade Tandingan Dan Menghancurkan Menara Lama. Team Persona Harus Berjuang Melindungi X Tower Asli Dengan Menghadapi Anak-Anak Zero.

programme.title: Ultraman Teo
programme.desc: Ultraman Teo Menceritakan Tentang Alien Kesepian Bernama Teo Yang Melarikan Diri Ke Bumi Setelah Planet Asalnya Hancur Diserang Kaiju. Di Bumi, Ia Hidup Sebagai Ibuki Mitsuishi, Seorang Mahasiswa Kedokteran Hewan Yang Berjuang Beradaptasi Dengan Manusia. Saat Monster Yang Sama Menyerang Bumi, Tekadnya Melindungi Makhluk Hidup Mengubahnya Menjadi Ultraman.

programme.title: Adu Kelas
programme.desc: Adu Kelas Merupakan Program Variety Show Yang Menayangkan Kompetisi Berupa Game Antar Angkatan Atau Antar Kelas Di Dalam Suatu Perlombaan, Menghadirkan Penampilan Bintang Tamu, Serta Menampilkan Pertunjukkan Minat Dan Bakat Siswa Siswi Sma Yang Menjadi Tuan Rumah. Program Ini Akan Dipandu Oleh Seorang Host Dan Duta Kelas Yang Pastinya Seru, Lucu Dan Kekinian.

programme.title: Mtlb Goo!
programme.desc: Program Magazine Yang Mengeksplor Tempat-Tempat Unik Dan Mendatangi Orang-Orang Dengan Kisah Menarik. Dikemas Dalam Bentuk Cerita Perjalanan Michael Tjandra Bersama Para Sahabat. Sehingga Selain Banyaknya Informasi Yang Diberikan, Keseruan Pengalaman Perjalanan Michael Tjandra Juga Dihadirkan Kepada Penonton.

programme.title: Abrakadabra

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Di Tengah Hutan Belantara, Terdapat Desa Rahasia Dihuni Oleh Sekelompok Makhluk Kecil Berwarna Biru Yang Dipimpin Oleh Papa Smurf. Para Smurf Tinggal Di Rumah Berbentuk Jamur Dan Hidup Dengan Damai. Namun, Kedatangan Penyihir Jahat Gargamel Dan Kucingnya, Azrael, Merusak Kedamaian Desa Tersebut. Sehingga Para Smurf Harus Mencari Cara Agar Tidak Ditangkap Oleh Gargamel Dan Azrael.

programme.title: Boboiboy Galaxy
programme.desc: Boboiboy Galaxy Merupakan Sebuah Kisah Tentang Robot-Robot Power Sphera Yang Dibuat Untuk Memberikan Kekuasaan Besar Kepada Pemiliknya. Namun, Proyek Power Sphera Akhirnya Dianggap Sebagai Proyek Yang Berbahaya Dan Dibatalkan, Sedangkan Power Sphera Yang Lain Melarikan Diri Dan Bersembunyi Di Berbagai Pelosok Galaksi.

programme.title: Ejen Ali
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Dengan Tokoh Utaman Bernama Ali Yang Tidak Sengaja Menjadi Agen Meta Advance Tactical Agency (Mata) Kemudian Dilatih Untuk Menjadi Agen Di Akademi Mata. Ali Membuktikan Diri Bahwa Ia Mampu Menjadi Agen Mata Dan Mengalahkan Musuh Bersama Alicia Dan Paman Bakar.

programme.title: Papa Pipi
